name: omameet
author: Dorneles
description: Universal MeetingBar for Omarchy: Shows upcoming meetings with countdown, 1-click join (Meet, Zoom, Teams), interactive agenda popup, bookmarks, music pause on join, and desktop alerts.

barWidget.description: Next meeting countdown, 1-click video call join, bookmarks, and calendar agenda popup

schema.label: Display Format
schema.description: Widget text format on the status bar.

schema.label: Bar Text Font Size (px)
schema.description: Font size for the meeting title and countdown on the status bar (in pixels). Set to 0 to use system/bar default size.

schema.label: Character Limit (Max Title Length)
schema.description: Maximum number of characters allowed for the meeting title before truncation or marquee.

schema.label: Marquee Text Animation
schema.description: Enable smooth horizontal scrolling for meeting titles that exceed the character limit.

schema.label: Marquee Cycle Duration (seconds)
schema.description: Duration of the marquee scroll animation cycle in seconds.

schema.label: Show Platform / Calendar Icon
schema.description: Show the video platform or calendar icon before the title.

schema.label: Show Countdown / Time Remaining
schema.description: Show relative time countdown (e.g. 'in 15 min' or '20 min left').

schema.label: Pause Music When Joining
schema.description: Automatically pause active MPRIS media players (Spotify, browser, etc.) when joining a meeting.

schema.label: Hide Declined Meetings
schema.description: Filter out meetings that you have declined or marked as cancelled.

schema.label: Hide Tentative Meetings
schema.description: Filter out tentative or unconfirmed meetings.

schema.label: Hide Pending Invites
schema.description: Filter out meeting invites requiring response (needs action).

schema.label: Hide All-Day Events
schema.description: Do not show all-day calendar events on the status bar or next meeting.

schema.label: Only Show Events with Video Links
schema.description: Filter out calendar events that do not contain a video meeting link.

schema.label: Auto-Refresh Interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to background sync calendar feeds in minutes.

schema.label: Urgent Warning Threshold (minutes)
schema.description: Highlight meeting in urgent warning color when starting in less than this threshold.

schema.label: Desktop Meeting Reminders
schema.description: Send desktop notification when an upcoming meeting is about to start.

schema.label: Notification Lead Time (minutes)
schema.description: How many minutes before the meeting to send the desktop reminder.

schema.label: Preferred Browser / App
schema.description: Custom browser executable to open meeting links (e.g. google-chrome-stable, firefox, brave). Leave empty for default.

schema.label: Open in Native App (Zoom/Teams)
schema.description: Launch native client application for Zoom/Teams instead of web browser if installed.
